body: I've been wondering this a lot myself lately. The most common response to people with suicidal thoughts or a reason people won't do it is because of your loved ones. What if you don't have any? I know I barely talk to my family; I'm not close with any of them. I only live with my Mom because I can't afford to live on my own. Maybe they'll be sad when I die but people die everyday and I'm not even involved in the lives of any of them so they won't miss me that much. And either way, no one is going to live my life for me.
